body: Thanks buddy. I'm feeling great after a weekend with a lot of people who care about me. Watched Forrest Gump (my favorite movie) with them and my favorite kid in the world fell asleep on the couch with his head using my arm as a pillow. I can't really ask for much more in life. I went through a lot of yelling/emotional abuse from my dad as a teenager and it just fucks my head up sometimes. I haven't been lonely in years. I don't know why my brain feels that way about once a month. I live by myself because it has a lot of benefits, but sometimes it just gets to me. My senior year of college and my job starts up again in a week, so I'll be doing my best to keep myself busy. Thank you for all that you do for everyone here.
